# THE AGENT DOOR'S WIRE WORDS (serve_door.rs, the agent door's root leg) -- golden input data, one
# `key = value` per line (`#` starts a comment). These are the linked plane's own words its
# Statement does not carry, as the root's door cells use them: the section its grammar reads (the
# door the cells drive is the linked plane door that owns it), its key (the `hooks:` container the
# cells attach an agent's hooks under), the mount its claims sit under, and the resource type its
# task rows are named by in a refusal's details.
#
# Copied from the line-served plane's own sources: lib.rs (CONFIG_SECTION, PLANE_KEY, MOUNT_PATH)
# and the task row's ErrorInfo resource type.
section = agents
plane_key = a2a
mount = /a2a
task_resource_type = a2a.busbar/task
# The domain of the ErrorInfo every A2A-defined error carries in its details.
error_info_domain = a2a-protocol.org
# The unit's audit row (door.rs AUDIT_ACTION, agent_resource): its action, and the kind its
# resource names the agent under (`<resource_kind>:<agent id>`).
audit_action = agent.call
resource_kind = agent
# The scope kind a key's grant names an agent under (door.rs SCOPE): `<scope_kind>:<agent id>`.
scope_kind = agent
# The section's subject noun in the config refusals (a2a/config.rs SUBJECT_NOUN), and the billable
# class a hop's moved bytes are counted in (meta.rs CLASS_BYTES).
subject_noun = fronted agent
bytes_class = bytes
# The gRPC binding (framed.rs SERVICE_PATH, binding.rs BINDING_GRPC): the service every rpc's path
# sits under, and the card word an agent serving it names.
grpc_service = /lf.a2a.v1.A2AService
grpc_binding = GRPC
# The callback an agent reports a task's move to (lib.rs MOUNT_PATH + PUSH_PATH_SUFFIX).
push_path = /a2a/push
# The domain busbar's card-signing key is derived under (door.rs CARD_SIGNING_DOMAIN).
card_signing_domain = a2a/agent-card-signing/v1
